name: PDF to Word

name: Excel to PDF

name: JPG to PDF

name: PPTX to PDF

name: HTML to PDF
desc: Convert HTML to PDF free in your browser. Real page layout, selectable text, no upload, no sign-up.

name: Markdown
desc: Convert Markdown — or plain text — to PDF in your browser. Headings, tables, code blocks and links, with selectable text. No upload, no account.

name: Email to PDF
desc: Turn an .eml email into a paginated PDF free in your browser. Headers, HTML body, embedded pictures, attachment list. Remote content is not loaded. No upload.

name: HEIC

name: PDF/A

name: Merge

name: Split
desc: Split PDF pages free in your browser. Extract a range or every page — no upload, no sign-up, no watermark.

name: Split by bookmark
desc: Split a PDF at any bookmark level, in your browser — the whole outline tree, not just the top. No bookmarks? Enter page ranges instead.

name: Split by size
desc: Split PDF by file size free in your browser. Break large PDFs into smaller parts — no upload.

name: Split scans
desc: Cut a book scan with two pages per sheet into single pages, in reading order. You place the gutter line and see it before anything is cut. In your browser, no upload.

name: Organize
desc: Reorder and delete PDF pages free in your browser. No upload, no sign-up, no watermark.

name: Rotate
desc: Rotate PDF pages 90°, 180°, or 270° free in your browser. No upload, no sign-up, no watermark.

name: Crop
desc: Crop PDF online free — drag a box on a live preview and the same trim applies to every page, in your browser. No upload.

name: Resize
desc: Resize PDF page dimensions free in your browser. A4, Letter, or custom — no upload.

name: Booklet
desc: Reorder and impose a PDF two pages to a landscape sheet, so a double-sided print folds into a booklet. Blank padding is counted and stated. In your browser, no upload.

name: Overlay
desc: Put a letterhead PDF behind your pages, or a stamp PDF over them, on every page or a range. Text in both layers stays selectable. In your browser, no upload.

name: Page numbers
desc: Add page numbers to PDF free in your browser. No upload, no sign-up, no watermark.

name: Headers
desc: Add running headers and footers to a PDF free in your browser. Page number, total, date and file name tokens, margins, and a distinct first page.

name: Remove blanks
desc: Measure the ink on every page of a scan, see the light ones with their percentages, and remove only the ones you confirm. In your browser, no upload.

name: Protect
desc: Password-protect PDF free in your browser. Encrypt with a user password — no upload, no sign-up.

name: Unlock
desc: Unlock password-protected PDF free in your browser. Enter your password — no upload, no sign-up.

name: Redact
desc: Redact PDF free in your browser. Search or draw boxes; the matched text is deleted from the page, not just covered. No upload.

name: Redaction log
desc: Build a redaction log for an already-redacted PDF, with the check run on the delivered bytes and a SHA-256 of each document. Free, in your browser.

name: Verify redaction
desc: Check whether a redacted PDF still contains the text underneath. Detects text under a filled box, invisible text, hidden layers and annotation covers. Free, in your browser.

name: Sanitize
desc: Check a PDF before you send it. See its metadata, comments, attachments, scripts, form values and hidden text, strip what you choose, and read the check made on the output. In your browser, no upload.

name: Remove annotations
desc: Remove annotations from a PDF free in your browser — comments, highlights, notes and markup stripped in one pass. No upload, no account.

name: Remove watermark
desc: Remove watermark objects from a PDF in your browser: watermark and stamp annotations, repeated form XObjects and transparent content-stream marks. Verified on the output. No upload.

name: Flatten
desc: Flatten PDF forms and annotations free in your browser. Bake them into static content — no upload.

name: Metadata
desc: Edit PDF title, author, and keywords free in your browser. No upload, no sign-up.

name: Watermark
desc: Add a text watermark to PDF free in your browser. No upload, no sign-up, no watermark on output.

name: Fill & sign
desc: Sign PDF free in your browser. Draw, type, or upload a signature — no upload to servers.

name: Sign
desc: Sign PDF free in your browser. Embed a drawn signature — not PKCS digital signature.

name: Make fillable
desc: Turn a flat PDF form into a fillable one, free in your browser. Draw text fields, check boxes and dropdowns where they belong, then read back the fields the saved file carries. No upload, no account.

name: Form doctor
desc: Find out why a PDF form says “Please wait”, will not save, or cannot be typed into outside Adobe Reader. See what the form is made of and what can be done. In your browser, no upload.

name: Exhibit stamps
desc: Stamp Exhibit A, B, C onto PDF files free in your browser. Auto-incrementing labels, optional cover sheet, exhibit index. No upload, no sign-up.

name: Bates numbering

name: Repair
desc: Rebuild a broken cross-reference table and keep the text where it survives — free in your browser, no upload.

name: Deskew

name: OCR
desc: OCR PDF free in your browser. 126 languages, columns read in order — no upload, no sign-up.

name: Extract images
desc: Extract images from a PDF without uploading it: every embedded photo and graphic is found in your browser and saved at original quality. Free, no account.

name: Compare
desc: Compare two PDFs visually free in your browser. Side-by-side render — no upload, no sign-up.

name: Edit
desc: Edit existing PDF text in your browser — click a paragraph, rewrite it in place, and the text reflows in the document's own font.

name: Passport photo

name: Remove background
